testcase.name: Atwater needs the macros to explain 90 percent of the dry matter
the two informational flags keep a row verified for the logger and a quality flag does not
an install holding the previous data version imports the catalog once more
real foundation foods without energy stay out unless Atwater can trust them and the ten negative carbohydrates are clamped
energy keeps the 2048 then 2047 then 1008 priority and ignores zero
oil per 100 ml is a density not a portion and the next row is used
the food item keeps the category and the Spanish aliases of the catalog row
foods that do not declare their carbohydrate stay out instead of getting a fraction of their energy
alcohol weighs 7 kcal per gram and is not read as an energy mismatch
fat comes from 1085 only when 1004 is absent
the entity carries the Spanish name, its aliases, the category and the portion
portions outside 5 g and the pack limit are skipped
without a Spanish name the English description stays as name and alias
a higher priority id wins even when its value is zero
amounts below one half are ignored because the source rounds them to one decimal
sugar comes from 1063 when 2000 is absent
alcohol comes from 1018
rows without trustworthy energy or with impossible macros do not enter the catalog
at equal seq_num the earlier row wins and a missing seq_num goes last
hard spaces and spare blanks are cleaned from the English description
sugar prefers 2000 over 1063 whichever row comes first
both corrections can apply to the same row
carbohydrate comes from 1050 only when 1005 is absent
malformed portion rows are skipped
the macros keep their values and the sugar comes from 1063
search aliases are the normalized Spanish name then the English one then the extras without repeats
protein, carbohydrate and fat weigh 4, 4 and 9 kcal per gram
the category is the description and an unknown id gives none
the first valid row by seq_num wins even when it appears later in the file
a slightly negative carbohydrate by difference is raised to zero and flagged
the other nutrients keep their single ids
a multi unit row is divided by its amount
a pure fat without energy gets 9 kcal per gram and the Atwater flag
the alias table is read with its pipe separated aliases
real portions describe one unit and never carry the raw measure unit id
the label joins the unit and its detail
the state still comes from the English description
real foundation rows build catalog entities with readable category, unit and names
the published energy wins over Atwater and the row carries no flag
an unknown category and a missing portion stay null
categories and measure units are read by id with quoted commas
the clamp stops at minus 2 g and a carbohydrate of zero or more is never flagged
real sugar is recovered from the 1063 id for most foundation foods
unmapped nutrients and unreadable amounts do not create or claim anything
an undetermined unit without detail is skipped and with detail it keeps the detail
every asset the import reads exists in the assets folder
one tablespoon of 13,6 g is the portion with its unit label
